description: Capability for the main window: this app's own file/engine bridge commands (see ../permissions/desktop-commands.toml), plus the dialog plugin used for open/save pickers throughout the studio. Deliberately excludes fs and shell plugin permissions — the frontend never calls those plugins' JS APIs directly, file I/O goes through the app's own load_file/save_file commands instead, so granting them would be broader than this app needs. See F-c1882c0f.
